reason: I fill my nights through PR people, WhatsApp lists and regulars, not apps. 500 people on a waitlist doesn't tell me how many will actually open it here, so I wouldn't pay anything until I see real numbers. I'd maybe let you load my flyers for free, since it costs me nothing.
objection: How many people actually use this app here? 500 sign-ups in a city is nothing next to my own lists, and I don't have time to look after one more channel.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the published monthly active users well past the threshold, and a few venues like mine saying it actually brought people through the door.
